name: revenue-expense-tracker
description: Australian personal finance, investment and tax-year tracker for retail investors, property investors, retirees and pensioners.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:vercel: npm run db:sync && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=backend && npm run test --workspace=frontend
